page_title: NOT 2-2 LEI | Nottingham Forest v Leicester 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: da Silva Moreira E. Ankle Injury

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Tony Harrington has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) sends a long ball forward to Victor Kristiansen, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
90+8' Leicester failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+7' Jeremy Monga (Leicester) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Leicester are going to take it.
90+5' Jakub Stolarczyk leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
90+3' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Caleb Okoli (Leicester) replacing Bilal El Khannouss.
90+3' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
90+1' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jota Silva (Nottingham) for Elliot Anderson.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
89' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) picks up an injury.
88' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is flagged for offside.
88' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
86' None of the Leicester players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
85' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahim Sangare leaves the pitch and Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) comes on.
81' 2 - 2 Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball in the middle of the goal.
80' A precise low pass is received by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
79' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) for a tough tackle.
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kasey McAteer as he is replaced by Jeremy Monga (Leicester).
77' Ruud van Nistelrooy decides to make a substitution. Luke Thomas will be replaced by Victor Kristiansen (Leicester).
74' It's time for a substitution. Ryan Yates (Nottingham) comes on in place of Nicolas Dominguez.
74' Dangerous play by Elliot Anderson (Nottingham). Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Tony Harrington shows the yellow card to Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) for a heavy challenge.
73' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) plays a through ball but overhits it.
70' Leicester can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
69' Ola Aina (Nottingham) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

67' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Matz Sels. This effort really didn't trouble him.
67' The referee blows his whistle as Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
61' Here is a change. Jordan Ayew is going off and Ruud van Nistelrooy gives the last tactical orders to Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester).
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Oliver Skipp walks off the pitch to be replaced by Boubakary Soumare (Leicester).
60' Today's referee Tony Harrington rightly decides to book Morato (Nottingham) for his harsh tackle.
58' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Luke Thomas (Leicester), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
58' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
56' 2 - 1 Chris Wood (Nottingham) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the left post.

53' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Jakub Stolarczyk pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
51' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
47' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is caught offside!
46' Referee Tony Harrington blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' A mistimed header from the middle of the box by Jamie Vardy (Leicester) goes well wide of the left post.
45+3' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Leicester.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is furious with himself. He nodded the ball from close range far wide of the right post!

44' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Jakub Stolarczyk has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
41' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) unleashes a shot from the free kick, but blazes it over. This is a perfect example of a wasted chance.
39' James Justin (Leicester) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tony Harrington ignores the protests.
37' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Chris Wood (Nottingham) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
35' The shots on goal statistics – 1:2.
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nottingham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' James Justin (Leicester) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tony Harrington blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Nottingham.
28' James Justin (Leicester) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

25' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Anthony Elanga flights the free kick into the box, where Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) peels off his marker and heads straight into the top of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:1.
25' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) will take the free kick.
22' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tony Harrington no option but to blow his whistle.
22' A lofted cross from Ola Aina (Nottingham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
21' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
19' Tony Harrington sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
17' Wait! Referee Tony Harrington has indicated he is going to review the Leicester goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
16' 0 - 1 An unlucky rebound falls to Conor Coady (Leicester) and he scores with a bullet header.

16' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Matz Sels makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
16' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Leicester, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

12' It looks like Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) saw red with that tackle. Tony Harrington won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Leicester are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
8' Tony Harrington blows for a foul after Oliver Skipp (Leicester) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
6' Chris Wood (Nottingham) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.
3' Chris Wood (Nottingham) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar.
3' A corner kick by Nottingham is thwarted by the well prepared Jakub Stolarczyk (Leicester).
2' Neco Williams (Nottingham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Nottingham get a corner.
1' The match has just started.
Nottingham will kick-off.
Tony Harrington will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
